QuestInfo.name: [Mechanical Hearts] Exotic, New, and Already Canceled
QuestInfo.0: Which #bWondroid#k you will rescue next?\r\nGo and see #bKat#k.
QuestInfo.1: #bKat#k told you about a Wondroid named #bSarim#k who served as her prototype.\r\nWith the Kat model complete, Aspire now intends to dispose of #bSarim#k...\r\n#bSneak into Aspire Industries B4#k with #bSpencer#k's help and save him!
QuestInfo.2: You escorted the Wondroid #bSarim#k to safety.\r\n#b[You can now purchase a Sarimroid from Alec's shop.]#k

0.msg: You still have to rescue #bSarim#k!\r\nTalk to #bSpencer#k to initiate a rescue mission and #bselect Sarim#k as your objective.
